text: 创业板指涨超2%，科创50指数涨超4%，半导体芯片、算力硬件、贵金属等方向涨幅居前，沪深京三市上涨个股近3900只
text_en: ChiNext Index rises more than 2%, STAR 50 Index rises more than 4%, semiconductor chips, computing power hardware, precious metals and other sectors lead gains, nearly 3,900 stocks rise across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets
